title: 把 Vault 当成 LDAP + TOTP 登录网关：两阶段登录与首次绑定
description: On a single Killercoda host: start OpenLDAP (with user alice), dev-mode Vault, and a tiny Go website on :8080. Vault is preconfigured with the four building blocks (auth/ldap, sys/mfa/method/totp/my-totp, sys/mfa/login-enforcement/ldap-mfa-enforce, identity entity+alias for alice — but NO TOTP secret yet). Step 1 walks through what is preconfigured. Step 2 reproduces the new-user chicken-and-egg lockout, then runs an enrollment script that calls admin-generate and registers the TOTP secret with oathtool. Step 3 drives a full two-phase login from curl, then from the browser via the Killercoda tab on port 8080. Step 4 explores negative cases (wrong OTP, reused mfa_request_id) and reads the structured audit log entries for the whole flow.

steps.title: 第一步：检查 Vault 里预置好的四块积木
第二步：复现新用户登录死循环并跑通 enrollment
第三步：用 curl 与浏览器分别跑完整两阶段登录
第四步：错误 OTP / 一次性 mfa_request_id / 审计日志
